mission: Where clinical data meet the decisions that shape their outcomes.

tracks.name: Prophecy
tracks.tagline: What exactly does an ICU mortality prediction predict?
tracks.description: An open research program examining the feedback between illness, clinical decisions, monitoring, and recorded outcomes.
tracks.discipline: Intensive care · Causal inference · Operations research

tracks.name: Prophecy 2
tracks.eyebrow: Research track 02 · DNR decision and causal identification
tracks.tagline: Does a DNR order change care—or record a decision already underway?
tracks.description: A deliberate fork back to the DNR question. We distinguish DNR-only from DNR/DNI, reconstruct the order timeline, measure changes in non-CPR care, and test where causal interpretation fails.
tracks.discipline: Intensive care · End-of-life decisions · Causal inference

editorial.release_policy: Aggregate results only; versioned, source-linked, methods-first.
editorial.update_model: Every reviewed and merged research release appears automatically on the site.
